metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent added note 'APP' and purple background. This variation chains that with filling the empty title placeholder.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can add slide notes, change background color, and type text into title placeholders in LibreOffice Impress.
metadata.explanation: Chains original task (note + purple background) with adding a slide title. Evaluator checks: notes text 'APP' (0.33), purple background (0.34), and title text 'Product Features' (0.33). The slide initially has an empty title placeholder, so initial state fails.

llm_judge_reasons: All three instruction requirements are covered: notes text 'APP' (0.33), purple background (0.34), and slide title 'Product Features' (0.33) with appropriate partial credit scoring.
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric accesses rules dict directly via expected.get('notes_text') and expected.get('expected_title') without the anti-pattern expected.get('rules', {}).
Getter correctly extracts notes text from slide.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text.strip(), background RGB from fill.fore_color.rgb, and title text from slide.shapes.title.text.strip().
Postconfig saves the file with Ctrl+S before evaluation, ensuring the PPTX on disk reflects the agent's changes.
Purple heuristic (r>=64, b>=64, g<128, r-g>30, b-g>30) correctly identifies standard LibreOffice purple colors (e.g., #7030A0: r=112, g=48, b=160).
Edge cases handled: missing notes slide (has_notes_slide check), missing title shape (None check), getter error propagation, invalid RGB parsing (try/except ValueError).
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: If the user sets background via a theme color rather than a direct RGB, fill.fore_color.rgb raises an exception and bg_rgb becomes None, failing the purple check. Consider also checking fill.fore_color.theme_color and resolving it to an RGB approximation as a fallback.
